title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
If you are an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal who enjoys managing your own caseload but also values being part of a supportive team, this could be a really good opportunity for you.

You will be joining an established property team where you will have responsibility for managing your own transactions, including residential purchases and sales, transfers of title, remortgages and property transactions arising from executry matters.

Alongside managing your own caseload, you will work closely with Solicitors and Partners, providing support on more complex transactions and helping ensure clients receive a consistently high standard of service.

Your day-to-day work will include examining titles, negotiating missives, preparing legal documentation, dealing with settlements, LBTT returns and Land Register applications. You will have plenty of responsibility and the opportunity to continue developing your technical knowledge and experience.
Ideally you will be a qualified Paralegal (or willing to work towards qualification) with previous Residential Conveyancing experience, and comfortable managing transactions with minimal supervision. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and, importantly, enjoy working with clients and colleagues.

You should be confident managing competing deadlines, have good IT skills and take a practical, solutions-focused approach to your work.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys Residential Conveyancing, wants to take ownership of their work and would welcome being part of a collaborative team where they can continue to develop their career.

A competitive salary and discretionary bonus form part of the terms and benefits on offer.

If you would like to know more, please get in touch with me Deborah Collier at QED Legal on the details provided.

title: Private Client Paralegal
description:
For someone who enjoys executry work, takes pride in providing a really good service to clients and would welcome the opportunity to join a busy, established Private Client team, this could be a great move.

You'll be joining a friendly and supportive Private Client department where your experience will be valued and you'll have the opportunity to manage a varied and interesting caseload.

Ideally, you'll already have good experience of dealing with all aspects of executry administration, including both testate and intestate estates, as well as more complex matters involving taxable estates.

You'll be someone who is highly organised, confident managing your workload and comfortable dealing directly with clients.

As we know, executry work often involves supporting people at a particularly difficult time in their lives, so having a compassionate approach, excellent communication skills and a genuine commitment to looking after your clients is really important.

The role will be predominantly office based at their Aberdeen office, although there may be some opportunity for hybrid working once you've settled into the team.

For someone who enjoys Private Client work and would like to be part of a well-established firm where they can continue to develop their experience, I think this is a really good opportunity.

A competitive salary will be offered, depending on experience.

If you're considering your next move and would like to know more, please reach out to me, Deborah Collier at QED Legal, on the details provided.

All discussions will, of course, be completely confidential.
